body:
The Shard of Fein Uaill is a named monumental landmark within Fein Uaill. The regional map places it among the land’s major civic and defensive features, while the artwork depicts a radiant white tree towering over an immense city framed by mountains and water.

The image establishes the Shard’s intended scale and visual identity, but it does not by itself settle whether the tree is living, constructed, transformed, symbolic, or only one visible part of a larger structure. The Codex therefore treats the cityscape as a visual record and keeps its metaphysical explanation open.

A landmark large enough to organize a city

The surviving image makes the Shard the landscape’s dominant vertical feature. Streets, towers, gardens, water, and fortifications appear to gather around it, showing how a monumental place can orient civic space even when its government and founding story remain unrecovered.

The public boundary

The Shard’s ancient origin, divine significance, powers, custodians, and relationship to the world’s oldest catastrophes are not part of the public record. Those questions belong behind the keeper boundary until players discover them in the campaign.

The open record

The settlement surrounding the Shard, the meaning of the alias Rem Uaill, access to the monument, present-day rites, and its relationship to Zarathis, Ciaránach, and the Shining Shores remain unresolved.
